observations: The image is a professional product render or stock photo with a solid black background.
The brand 'hp' is visible on the front logo.
The model 'HP Smart Tank 581' is printed on the bottom right of the printer chassis.
A watermark 'BLESSED STAN PAUL' is visible across the center.
Four integrated ink tanks (CMYK) are visible on the front left.
A printed page is shown in the output tray.

claims.evidence: The scanner bed is not visible in the photo.
No cables are shown and wireless functionality cannot be confirmed from a still image.
This is a manufacturer's page yield specification for the black ink tank.

risks.risk: The item may not exist or be in a different condition than described because a stock photo was used.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual printer in a real-world environment with a handwritten note showing the date and seller's name.

risks.risk: Print heads may be clogged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the printer producing a clean nozzle check pattern or status report.

risks.risk: Ink tanks may be empty or contain non-genuine ink.
risks.proof: A photo of the ink levels in the tanks and the ink bottles used for refilling.

proof_requests: A photo of the actual printer in a real room (not a stock image) with a handwritten note of today's date and the seller's name.
A video of the printer in operation, specifically printing a test page.
Photos of the top scanner bed and the rear connection ports.
response.reason: The seller has provided a stock photo instead of a photograph of the actual unit. For second-hand electronics, a valuation requires seeing the physical condition of the specific item being sold to verify its existence and state.
